How Doorstep Scrap Pickup Works

See how to check your PIN code, select scrap items, choose a pickup slot, and receive transparent payment with Kabad Factory.

1. Check Pickup Availability

Enter your PIN code so the backend can verify serviceability and pickup charge using configured stores and charge slabs.

2. Select Scrap Items

Choose paper, metal, plastic, appliance, or e-waste categories and add an estimated weight.

3. Schedule a Slot

Login or register, select address, date and time, then create the pickup request.

4. Weigh, Pay, and Bill

The executive records actual weights, final payable amount, payment status, and bill details.
